name: std::wctrans
intro: Constructs a value of type std::wctrans_t that describes a LC_CTYPE category of wide character mapping. It may be one of the standard mappings, or a locale-specific mapping, such as "tojhira" or "tojkata".

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
str

 -

 C string holding the name of the desired mapping.
The following values of str are supported in all C locales:




 Value of str

 Effect




 "toupper"

 identifies the mapping used by towupper




 "tolower"

 identifies the mapping used by towlower

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: std::wctrans_t object suitable for use with std::towctrans to map wide characters according to the named mapping of the current C locale or zero if str does not name a mapping supported by the current C locale.
